registry_candidates.name: layout_version_counters
registry_candidates.entry_yaml:
- purpose: layout_version_counters
  status: active           # ADR-0014 is Proposed
  api: "per-section int64 version/static_version/leaf_version in private columns behind bounds-guarded getters (compare for inequality only; 0 = no live section; invalidate to 0 on discard; at restore every LIVE section is 1 and every other section 0); non-persisted version_epoch incremented by restore and default_state (new_epoch also resets every changed_region stamp_tick to -1), consumers cache (version_epoch, version) and an epoch change gates only result-neutral cache rebuilds; changed_region is simulation-side, lazily valid only when stamp_tick == ClockView.tick(), merge lattice ALL > REGION(union) > FRAME, advisory after a restore"
  not: "persisting or hashing a counter, stamp or version_epoch; a presentation read of changed_region; relying on changed_region == ALL after a restore; reusing 0 for a live section; confusing version_epoch with restore_epoch; feeding a version_epoch change into a work budget, persisted value or RNG draw"
  adr: docs/architecture/adr-0014-geometry-broadphase-and-occluder-source-seam.md
  reason: "a reset-to-1 version can equal a stale cached value after restore; the epoch closes it in the type"
  referenced_by:
    - docs/architecture/adr-0014-geometry-broadphase-and-occluder-source-seam.md
  added: 2026-10-29
  revised: ""

registry_candidates.name: broadphase_cell_coupling

  reason: "TR-shipbody-037; a swept foot box of width at most FOOT_BOX_W + V_RUN touches at most 2 cells per axis iff cell >= that width; packed int32 writes truncate silently so coordinates must stay far from the sentinels"

registry_candidates.name: changed_region_read_outside_its_tick

gdd_sync.old:
func rects_in(aabb: Rect2i, out: QueryBuffer) -> void             # Layout OccluderSource
func solid_in(body_id: int, aabb: Rect2i, out: QueryBuffer) -> void
gdd_sync.new:
func rects_in(body_id: int, ax0: int, ay0: int, ax1: int, ay1: int, out: QueryBuffer) -> int   # Layout OccluderSource (ADR-0014); spans are occupied (x0, y0, x1-1, y1-1)
func solid_in(body_id: int, ax0: int, ay0: int, ax1: int, ay1: int, out: QueryBuffer) -> int   # Layout SolidQuery (ADR-0014); wrapped only by ADR-0015 LayoutCollide

gdd_sync.old: | `QueryBuffer`, `SolidQuery`, `OccluderSource` | ADR-0014 |
gdd_sync.new: | `QueryBuffer`, `RegionBox`, `ChangedRegion`, `SolidQuery`, `OccluderSource` | ADR-0014 (Proposed) |

gdd_sync.old: func solid_in(_rect: Rect2i, _out: QueryBuffer) -> int:
gdd_sync.new: func solid_in(_body_id: int, _ax0: int, _ay0: int, _ax1: int, _ay1: int, _out: QueryBuffer) -> int:   # placeholder aligned to ADR-0014 (src/ implementations prefix unused parameters with _; the @abstract port keeps plain names, V6 probed)

gdd_sync.old: `occluder_source(body_id) -> OccluderSource` exposes `rects_in(aabb)` and `version(section_id)` with EM-20's names verbatim
gdd_sync.new: one world-wide `OccluderSource` port exposes `rects_in(body_id, ax0, ay0, ax1, ay1, out)`, `section_rects_into(section_id, mask, out)`, `version(section_id)`, `static_version`, `leaf_version`, `version_epoch()`, `changed_region_*`, `section_of_key` and `idx_of_key` (ADR-0014; `body_id` is an argument, there is no per-body bound handle); `SolidQuery.solid_in(body_id, ax0, ay0, ax1, ay1, out)` takes the same box form; output spans are occupied spans and a half-open consumer converts once with `+ 1`

gdd_sync.old: It is bumped by `build_section`, `attach_section`, `detach_section`, `discard_section_geometry`, `layout.doors` and Layout's own `post_restore`
gdd_sync.new: It is bumped by `build_section`, `attach_section`, `detach_section`, `layout.doors` and Layout's own `post_restore`; `discard_section_geometry` sets all three counters of the discarded section to 0 (the 'no live section' value, ADR-0014; replaces the bump); at restore every live section's counters are 1 and every other section 0; `version_epoch` (non-persisted, +1 on restore and default_state, which also resets every changed_region stamp_tick to -1) is the unconditional-rebuild signal; `changed_region` validity is a tick stamp compared with the clock, not a clearing pass, and it is advisory after a restore

gdd_sync.old: each consumer owns one buffer and `clear()` resets its length without releasing capacity.
gdd_sync.new: each consumer owns one buffer; a query overwrites it, `count` is the only valid length, `status` distinguishes an empty box and an unknown body from 'no rectangles', `cells_touched` and `candidates_tested` expose the deterministic work counts, and overflow calls a cold counted geometric `grow()` (never truncates) (ADR-0014).

gdd_sync.old: `cost(query) = t_call + cells × ( t_cell + rects_per_cell × t_dedup ) + t_merge(candidates) + candidates × t_test + N_dyn × t_bbox + t_merge_dyn(N_hit)`
gdd_sync.new: `cost(query) = t_call + t_adapter + cells × t_cell + entries × t_stamp + c × (t_test + t_insert + t_emit)`: door leaves and socket plates are in the grid at their maximum footprint (ADR-0014), so the N_dyn scan and the dynamic merge terms are removed; the swept box is Body D.12's (`FOOT_BOX_W + |step|` wide), not `[px − 8 − v, px + 8 + v)`

gdd_sync.old: behind an **`OccluderSource` seam** (`rects_in(aabb)`, ascending rect id; `version(section_id)`
gdd_sync.new: behind an **`OccluderSource` seam** (`rects_in(body_id, ax0, ay0, ax1, ay1, out)`, ascending rect key into a caller-owned `QueryBuffer` of occupied spans; `version(section_id)`, `static_version`, `version_epoch()`, `changed_region_*`

gdd_sync.old: `occluder_source(body_id) -> OccluderSource` per body, `rects_in(aabb)` answering in that body's frame
gdd_sync.new: one `OccluderSource` port with explicit `body_id`: `rects_in(body_id, ...)` and the bulk `section_rects_into(section_id, mask, out)` answer in the body frame as occupied spans (polygon corners at `(x0, y0)` and `(x1_occ + 1, y1_occ + 1)`, no Layout shift); the builder caches `(version_epoch, version)` and never reads `changed_region`

gdd_sync.old: `BROADPHASE_CELL_PX >= FOOT_BOX_W + 3`
gdd_sync.new: `BROADPHASE_CELL_PX >= max(FOOT_BOX_W, FOOT_BOX_H) + V_RUN` (the BOOT invariant BROADPHASE_CELL_COUPLING of ADR-0014; the former constant 3 is V_RUN); `solid_in_into(body_id, aabb, out)` is `SolidQuery.solid_in(body_id, ax0, ay0, ax1, ay1, out) -> int`, reached through `LayoutCollide` (ADR-0015), with `x1 = spans[4k+2] + 1` decoded in one place

gdd_sync.old: # Coupling: BROADPHASE_CELL_PX >= FOOT_BOX_W + 3 (D.12 4-cell bound)
gdd_sync.new: # Coupling: BROADPHASE_CELL_PX >= max(FOOT_BOX_W, FOOT_BOX_H) + V_RUN (D.12 4-cell bound; ADR-0014 BROADPHASE_CELL_COUPLING)

gdd_sync.old: The coupling `BROADPHASE_CELL_PX >= FOOT_BOX_W + 3` is a boot-checked constraint
gdd_sync.new: The coupling `BROADPHASE_CELL_PX >= max(FOOT_BOX_W, FOOT_BOX_H) + V_RUN` (V_RUN is the 3 of the original wording) is a boot-checked constraint

gdd_sync.old: | ADR-0007 + ADR-0014 | 1 | TR-emitter-044 |
gdd_sync.new: | ADR-0017 | (add TR-emitter-044; re-tagged 2026-10-29, row 272) |

gdd_sync.old: `occluder_source(body_id) -> OccluderSource` exposes `rects_in(aabb)` and `version(section_id)` with EM-20's names verbatim
gdd_sync.new: one world-wide `OccluderSource` port exposes `rects_in(body_id, ax0, ay0, ax1, ay1, out)`, `section_rects_into(section_id, mask, out)`, `version(section_id)`, `static_version`, `leaf_version`, `version_epoch()`, `changed_region_*`, `section_of_key` and `idx_of_key` (ADR-0014; `body_id` is an argument, there is no per-body bound handle); `SolidQuery.solid_in(body_id, ax0, ay0, ax1, ay1, out)` takes the same box form; output spans are occupied spans and a half-open consumer converts once with `+ 1`

gdd_sync.old: It is bumped by `build_section`, `attach_section`, `detach_section`, `discard_section_geometry`, `layout.doors` and Layout's own `post_restore`
gdd_sync.new: It is bumped by `build_section`, `attach_section`, `detach_section`, `layout.doors` and Layout's own `post_restore`; `discard_section_geometry` sets all three counters of the discarded section to 0 (the 'no live section' value, ADR-0014; replaces the bump); at restore every live section's counters are 1 and every other section 0; `version_epoch` (non-persisted, +1 on restore and default_state, which also resets every changed_region stamp_tick to -1) is the unconditional-rebuild signal; `changed_region` validity is a tick stamp compared with the clock, not a clearing pass, and it is advisory after a restore

gdd_sync.old: each consumer owns one buffer and `clear()` resets its length without releasing capacity.
gdd_sync.new: each consumer owns one buffer; a query overwrites it, `count` is the only valid length, `status` distinguishes an empty box and an unknown body from 'no rectangles', `cells_touched` and `candidates_tested` expose the deterministic work counts, and overflow calls a cold counted geometric `grow()` (never truncates) (ADR-0014).

gdd_sync.old: `cost(query) = t_call + cells × ( t_cell + rects_per_cell × t_dedup ) + t_merge(candidates) + candidates × t_test + N_dyn × t_bbox + t_merge_dyn(N_hit)`
gdd_sync.new: `cost(query) = t_call + t_adapter + cells × t_cell + entries × t_stamp + c × (t_test + t_insert + t_emit)`: door leaves and socket plates are in the grid at their maximum footprint (ADR-0014), so the N_dyn scan and the dynamic merge terms are removed; the swept box is Body D.12's (`FOOT_BOX_W + |step|` wide), not `[px − 8 − v, px + 8 + v)`

gdd_sync.old: behind an **`OccluderSource` seam** (`rects_in(aabb)`, ascending rect id; `version(section_id)`

gdd_sync.old: `occluder_source(body_id) -> OccluderSource` per body, `rects_in(aabb)` answering in that body's frame
gdd_sync.new: one `OccluderSource` port with explicit `body_id`: `rects_in(body_id, ...)` and the bulk `section_rects_into(section_id, mask, out)` answer in the body frame as occupied spans (polygon corners at `(x0, y0)` and `(x1_occ + 1, y1_occ + 1)`, no Layout shift); the builder caches `(version_epoch, version)` and never reads `changed_region`

gdd_sync.new: `BROADPHASE_CELL_PX >= max(FOOT_BOX_W, FOOT_BOX_H) + V_RUN` (the BOOT invariant BROADPHASE_CELL_COUPLING of ADR-0014; the former constant 3 is V_RUN); `solid_in_into(body_id, aabb, out)` is `SolidQuery.solid_in(body_id, ax0, ay0, ax1, ay1, out) -> int`, reached through `LayoutCollide` (ADR-0015), with `x1 = spans[4k+2] + 1` decoded in one place

gdd_sync.new: # Coupling: BROADPHASE_CELL_PX >= max(FOOT_BOX_W, FOOT_BOX_H) + V_RUN (D.12 4-cell bound; ADR-0014 BROADPHASE_CELL_COUPLING)

func rects_in(aabb: Rect2i, out: QueryBuffer) -> void             # Layout OccluderSource

gdd_sync.new:
func rects_in(body_id: int, ax0: int, ay0: int, ax1: int, ay1: int, out: QueryBuffer) -> int   # Layout OccluderSource (ADR-0014); spans are occupied (x0, y0, x1-1, y1-1)
func solid_in(body_id: int, ax0: int, ay0: int, ax1: int, ay1: int, out: QueryBuffer) -> int   # Layout SolidQuery (ADR-0014); wrapped only by ADR-0015 LayoutCollide

gdd_sync.old: | `QueryBuffer`, `SolidQuery`, `OccluderSource` | ADR-0014 |
gdd_sync.new: | `QueryBuffer`, `RegionBox`, `ChangedRegion`, `SolidQuery`, `OccluderSource` | ADR-0014 (Proposed) |

gdd_sync.old: func solid_in(_rect: Rect2i, _out: QueryBuffer) -> int:
gdd_sync.new: func solid_in(_body_id: int, _ax0: int, _ay0: int, _ax1: int, _ay1: int, _out: QueryBuffer) -> int:   # placeholder aligned to ADR-0014 (src/ implementations prefix unused parameters with _; the @abstract port keeps plain names, V6 probed)

gdd_sync.old: `occluder_source(body_id) -> OccluderSource` exposes `rects_in(aabb)` and `version(section_id)` with EM-20's names verbatim
gdd_sync.new: one world-wide `OccluderSource` port exposes `rects_in(body_id, ax0, ay0, ax1, ay1, out)`, `section_rects_into(section_id, mask, out)`, `version(section_id)`, `static_version`, `leaf_version`, `version_epoch()`, `changed_region_*`, `section_of_key` and `idx_of_key` (ADR-0014; `body_id` is an argument, there is no per-body bound handle); `SolidQuery.solid_in(body_id, ax0, ay0, ax1, ay1, out)` takes the same box form; output spans are occupied spans and a half-open consumer converts once with `+ 1`

gdd_sync.old: It is bumped by `build_section`, `attach_section`, `detach_section`, `discard_section_geometry`, `layout.doors` and Layout's own `post_restore`
gdd_sync.new: It is bumped by `build_section`, `attach_section`, `detach_section`, `layout.doors` and Layout's own `post_restore`; `discard_section_geometry` sets all three counters of the discarded section to 0 (the 'no live section' value, ADR-0014; replaces the bump); at restore every live section's counters are 1 and every other section 0; `version_epoch` (non-persisted, +1 on restore and default_state, which also resets every changed_region stamp_tick to -1) is the unconditional-rebuild signal; `changed_region` validity is a tick stamp compared with the clock, not a clearing pass, and it is advisory after a restore

gdd_sync.old: each consumer owns one buffer and `clear()` resets its length without releasing capacity.
gdd_sync.new: each consumer owns one buffer; a query overwrites it, `count` is the only valid length, `status` distinguishes an empty box and an unknown body from 'no rectangles', `cells_touched` and `candidates_tested` expose the deterministic work counts, and overflow calls a cold counted geometric `grow()` (never truncates) (ADR-0014).

gdd_sync.old: `cost(query) = t_call + cells × ( t_cell + rects_per_cell × t_dedup ) + t_merge(candidates) + candidates × t_test + N_dyn × t_bbox + t_merge_dyn(N_hit)`
gdd_sync.new: `cost(query) = t_call + t_adapter + cells × t_cell + entries × t_stamp + c × (t_test + t_insert + t_emit)`: door leaves and socket plates are in the grid at their maximum footprint (ADR-0014), so the N_dyn scan and the dynamic merge terms are removed; the swept box is Body D.12's (`FOOT_BOX_W + |step|` wide), not `[px − 8 − v, px + 8 + v)`

gdd_sync.old: behind an **`OccluderSource` seam** (`rects_in(aabb)`, ascending rect id; `version(section_id)`
gdd_sync.new: behind an **`OccluderSource` seam** (`rects_in(body_id, ax0, ay0, ax1, ay1, out)`, ascending rect key into a caller-owned `QueryBuffer` of occupied spans; `version(section_id)`, `static_version`, `version_epoch()`, `changed_region_*`

gdd_sync.old: `occluder_source(body_id) -> OccluderSource` per body, `rects_in(aabb)` answering in that body's frame
gdd_sync.new: one `OccluderSource` port with explicit `body_id`: `rects_in(body_id, ...)` and the bulk `section_rects_into(section_id, mask, out)` answer in the body frame as occupied spans (polygon corners at `(x0, y0)` and `(x1_occ + 1, y1_occ + 1)`, no Layout shift); the builder caches `(version_epoch, version)` and never reads `changed_region`

gdd_sync.old: `BROADPHASE_CELL_PX >= FOOT_BOX_W + 3`
gdd_sync.new: `BROADPHASE_CELL_PX >= max(FOOT_BOX_W, FOOT_BOX_H) + V_RUN` (the BOOT invariant BROADPHASE_CELL_COUPLING of ADR-0014; the former constant 3 is V_RUN); `solid_in_into(body_id, aabb, out)` is `SolidQuery.solid_in(body_id, ax0, ay0, ax1, ay1, out) -> int`, reached through `LayoutCollide` (ADR-0015), with `x1 = spans[4k+2] + 1` decoded in one place

gdd_sync.old: # Coupling: BROADPHASE_CELL_PX >= FOOT_BOX_W + 3 (D.12 4-cell bound)
gdd_sync.new: # Coupling: BROADPHASE_CELL_PX >= max(FOOT_BOX_W, FOOT_BOX_H) + V_RUN (D.12 4-cell bound; ADR-0014 BROADPHASE_CELL_COUPLING)

gdd_sync.old: The coupling `BROADPHASE_CELL_PX >= FOOT_BOX_W + 3` is a boot-checked constraint
gdd_sync.new: The coupling `BROADPHASE_CELL_PX >= max(FOOT_BOX_W, FOOT_BOX_H) + V_RUN` (V_RUN is the 3 of the original wording) is a boot-checked constraint

gdd_sync.old: | ADR-0007 + ADR-0014 | 1 | TR-emitter-044 |
gdd_sync.new: | ADR-0017 | (add TR-emitter-044; re-tagged 2026-10-29, row 272) |
